summary: Full e2e verification of GlennTek deployment. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (auth, leads CRUD, admin CMS/pages generation, SEO, locations, CSRF/origin protection, settings validation, sitemap/robots). Frontend: homepage renders fully (hero-title visible in PT and /en); all requested pages (/reparacoes, /localizacoes, /faq, /contactos, /orcamento, /reparacao-iphone, /blog, /blog/quando-substituir-bateria-iphone) return 200 with proper H1s. Quote/lead form submission from /orcamento posts to /api/leads and returns 201 with success confirmation card (reference code shown). Admin login at /admin works with provided credentials, dashboard loads showing the submitted lead. SEO: /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt return 200 (served at root via ingress); /api/health returns {status: ok}. The reported concern about the homepage stuck on the loading spinner is NOT reproducible in a real browser — homepage mounts cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: HTML5 pattern attribute value "[+0-9() \-]{7,24}" is invalid in modern browsers (Chrome logs: 'Invalid character in character class' when parsing as /v regex). Native browser validation for phone silently disabled; server-side validation still enforces the pattern so functionality is not broken, but client-side hint is lost.

action_items: Optional: fix QuoteForm phone pattern regex to be Unicode-mode safe, e.g. pattern="[+0-9()\-\s]{7,24}" (escape dash or put it at the end of the character class).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting on /api/auth/login is 8 attempts / 15 min per IP — reasonable but be aware repeated automated tests can hit the cap; existing tests now clear rate_limits collection at start.
Cookie/CSRF pattern (HttpOnly session + X-CSRF-Token header + Origin check) is correctly enforced; verified via test_05.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_glenntek_api.py (switched admin creds to real admin@glenntek.com from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; stopped fixture from deleting the real admin; forced empty X-CSRF-Token on the negative-case PUT in test_05)
seed_data_creation: One test lead was created via UI submission (TEST_UI Lead) and cleaned up afterwards. Backend pytest also creates/deletes TEST_ leads and test-* CMS pages via cleanup fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Before running the backend suite, run `mongosh --quiet --eval 'db=db.getSiblingDB("glanetek_database"); db.rate_limits.deleteMany({});'` to avoid login rate-limit false failures. Admin credentials are the real ones (admin@glenntek.com / GlennTek@2026!); the test fixture no longer deletes the admin. SEO endpoints are at root (/sitemap.xml, /robots.txt) — not under /api. FRONTEND_ORIGIN in backend/.env intentionally points to the ...cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud origin due to ingress rewriting; do not change to the public preview URL or auth will break.
rca of the issue: N/A — the reported 'homepage stuck on loading spinner' was a false positive from the screenshot tool. Real-browser Playwright renders hero-title within ~2s and /api/site returns 200 quickly.
